d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : bihar ke bahubli neta anant sinh ke ghar in dinon shadi ki khushiyan chhaee huee hain... unki beti shivangi ki haldi seremni ki pahli tasviren aur vidiyo samne aae hain... haldi ke khas mauke par shivangi dasti pink kalar ke khubsurat lahange men najar aaeen... shivangi ne apne bhaee ke sath graind entri ki... is dauran unki bari bahan bhi sath dikhaee din... vahin, pile kurte men najar aae bhaee aur jija ne bhi samaroh men sabka dhyan khincha... bhavy sajavat aur parivar ke utsah ke bich shivangi ki haldi seremni ka vidiyo soshal midiya par charcha men hai
